verdict.rationale: Daryanani Law Group is a boutique, attorney-led immigration law firm offering personal legal services such as O-1, H-1B and EB-1 work. Software-style bulk operations across many items do not apply to this kind of product. The evidence shows no client portal or tooling that would make the axis apply, and the llms.txt and OpenAPI probes both returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
